packageRules.description: Hold the dependency slot 'typescript' (currently the TypeScript 6 API shim via npm:@typescript/typescript6) within the range the installed typescript-eslint 8.71.2 supports (peerDependencies: typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0; typescript-eslint#10940 tracks TS 7 compiler API support). Typecheck runs TypeScript 7 via @typescript/native. Revisit when the installed typescript-eslint supports a newer TypeScript.

Hold the resolved TypeScript 6 shim package within the range the installed typescript-eslint 8.71.2 supports, regardless of which manifest key installs it. Same constraint and revisit condition as the 'typescript' depName rule.

TypeScript 7 native tsc, installed as an npm alias of typescript (depName @typescript/native, packageName typescript). Keyed on depName because matchPackageNames compares the resolved packageName, which is typescript. Do not collapse this back into the typescript key; that key is the v6 API shim eslint imports.
